items.description: Imports the certificate, key and chain into AWS Certificate Manager (or reimports into an existing ACM certificate).

config_fields.label: AWS region
config_fields.help: AWS region of the ACM certificate store.

config_fields.label: Existing ACM certificate ARN
config_fields.help: Reimport into this ACM certificate instead of importing a new one.

credential_fields.label: Access key ID
credential_fields.help: Access key of an IAM identity allowed to import certificates into ACM.

items.description: Deploys the certificate, key and chain to an F5 BIG-IP via the iControl REST API and, optionally, binds them into a client-SSL profile.

config_fields.label: Partition
config_fields.help: Administrative partition the certificate, key, chain and client-SSL profile are created in (default Common).

config_fields.label: SSL profile
config_fields.help: Client-SSL profile to bind the certificate into (name in the partition or /Partition/name). Created (ciphers DEFAULT) when it does not exist; otherwise its certificate and key are updated. The uploaded chain is bound in both cases. Rollback never deletes it. Empty: no profile is touched.

credential_fields.label: Host
credential_fields.help: Management address of the BIG-IP (host or host:port).

credential_fields.label: Username
credential_fields.help: iControl REST user allowed to manage certificates and SSL profiles.

credential_fields.label: Password
credential_fields.help: Password of the iControl REST user.

items.description: Uploads the certificate as a Cloudflare custom certificate for one zone.

config_fields.label: Zone ID
config_fields.help: Cloudflare dashboard → the zone → Overview → API → Zone ID.

credential_fields.label: API token
credential_fields.help: API token with the permission Zone → SSL and Certificates → Edit for this zone.

items.description: Simulates a deployment without contacting anything; for testing jobs and automation.

config_fields.label: Fail
config_fields.help: Simulate a failed deployment.

items.description: Imports the certificate and key as a local certificate on a FortiGate (FortiOS REST API) and binds it into SSL/SSH inspection profiles.

config_fields.label: VDOM
config_fields.help: Virtual domain the certificate is managed in.

config_fields.label: Import scope
config_fields.help: Import the certificate globally or into the VDOM only.

config_fields.label: Replace strategy

options.label: SSL profile (import dated, bind into profiles, never delete)
Rebind (import dated, repoint all references, prune old)
Delete (delete and re-import under the same name)

config_fields.help: How a renewal replaces the certificate. SSL profile stops for manual review when the certificate is used outside its profiles; Rebind repoints SSL/SSH profiles, SSL-VPN, admin GUI and VIPs; Delete fails while the certificate is in use.

config_fields.label: Profile suffix
config_fields.help: SSL profile strategy: suffix of the provider-owned SSL/SSH inspection profile <certificate name><suffix>, created by cloning an existing replace-mode profile when missing.

config_fields.label: Default SSL profile
config_fields.help: SSL profile strategy: SSL/SSH inspection profile (server certificate mode replace) whose server certificate list is also updated in place; other domains' certificates are kept. Created when it does not exist.

config_fields.label: Rebind references
config_fields.help: Rebind strategy: repoint SSL/SSH profiles, SSL-VPN, admin GUI and VIPs from older certificates of the same name family to the new one.

config_fields.label: Prune old certificates
config_fields.help: Rebind strategy: delete superseded certificates of the same name family; certificates still in use are kept and reported.

credential_fields.label: Host
credential_fields.help: Management address of the FortiGate (host or host:port).

credential_fields.label: API token
credential_fields.help: Token of a REST API administrator allowed to manage certificates.

items.description: Delivers the certificate to inventory hosts through their agents (certbot layout).

config_fields.label: Hosts
config_fields.help: Inventory hosts that receive the certificate.

config_fields.label: Host tags
config_fields.help: key or key=value; a host must match all tags.

config_fields.label: Certificate name
config_fields.help: Directory name under live/ on the host; default from the common name.

config_fields.label: Private key
config_fields.help: Deliver the private key with the certificate, or only the certificate for hosts that generated their own key.

config_fields.label: Require all hosts
config_fields.help: Fail the deployment when any selected host fails or cannot receive certificates.

config_fields.label: Wait for hosts (s)
config_fields.help: How long a deployment waits for host results; hosts still offline are reported as queued.

items.description: Posts the certificate, chain and key as JSON to an HTTP endpoint you operate.

config_fields.label: Webhook URL
config_fields.help: Receives the deployment request (POST).

config_fields.label: Verify URL
config_fields.help: Receives verify requests; defaults to the webhook URL.

config_fields.label: Rollback URL
config_fields.help: Receives rollback requests; defaults to the webhook URL.

config_fields.label: Timeout (s)
config_fields.help: How long to wait for the endpoint.

config_fields.label: Skip TLS verification
config_fields.help: Only for endpoints with self-signed certificates.

config_fields.label: Custom headers
config_fields.help: Extra request headers; authentication headers belong in the credentials.

config_fields.label: Metadata
config_fields.help: Key/value pairs sent in the request payload.

credential_fields.label: Authorization header
credential_fields.help: Raw Authorization header value; takes precedence over the bearer token.
